// @path: src/app/ops/schools/FreezePanel.tsx
// An inline Server Action is its own POST endpoint with its own action id, so
// the guard belongs immediately after the directive, not on the page that
// rendered it. This is the passing half of bad-inline-server-action.txt.
"use client-not-really";
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";
import { freezeSchool } from "@/lib/ops/operations";

export default async function FreezePanel({ schoolId }) {
  await requireOperator();
  async function freeze(formData) {
    "use server";
    await requireOperator();
    return freezeSchool(schoolId, formData.get("reason"));
  }
  return <form action={freeze} />;
}
